playstyle: Five agile aelf killers with Move 4–5 and mixed saves who rely on fighter quality rather than any single mechanic. Khamyss threatens at reach with a high-dice blade, Kyrssa's Grievous criticals stagger opponents, and Kyrae covers ground quickest while keeping a ranged option in reserve. Playing with a generic Order warscroll rather than a bespoke one, the coven adapts to either aggressive treasure grabs or a home-territory counter-punch style. Victories come from precise target selection and superior mobility, isolating enemies before they can coordinate a response.
